ambient_events: The stove is fed one stick and the door shut quietly.
A curtain is pulled round a bed by somebody who does not look in first.
Somebody very small is being talked to, at length, about nothing.
description: A low warm building with the thickest walls in the town and a stove going in it year round. There is a bell outside the door, and a chalked list of who is on call, and the list has nine names on it and covers every hour of the week.
name: The Whelping Room
